verdict.rationale: Bento's quickstart says coding agents load its docs over MCP after installing the Agent Skills, so an agent connects to a Bento-provided MCP source. That source appears limited to documentation, and nothing shows agents reaching product data (traces, signals, issues) through it; those are exposed via the CLI instead. missing for 10: a documented official MCP server endpoint and setup, MCP tools for product operations (traces, signals, issues, alerts), auth and configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.
Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
